script_text: Pisces, as a Water sign ruled by Neptune, your 12th House is igniting this week — prepare for a shocking revelation about your past that completely changes everything. Monday brings a tense square between Mercury in Virgo and Neptune — communication gets messy, avoid signing contracts. Wednesday sees Venus trine your 7th House, making it ideal for deep romantic conversations. The Moon enters your 10th House of career on Wednesday afternoon, shifting your professional energy dramatically. Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter opposes Saturn in your 2nd House of finances — money matters demand careful planning. The weekend brings a sextile between Mars and Neptune, fueling unexpected creative breakthroughs. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of love and creativity. Monday is your worst day — Mercury squares Neptune, causing confusion and miscommunication. Trust your intuition on Thursday when your gut feeling about a financial decision proves correct. Follow for daily updates.
